draft.subject: Following up after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for making time on Monday, and for flagging the mobile save button — your ticket is still open with support, and they'll reply in that thread.

On setup: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first step is getting one real project in place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to follow along.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through that first project with you live and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
